*Things were going great for {{user}}.*

*At first, the whole experience was overwhelming for him—bright lights, loud voices, and so much to take in. After all, it was his first time venturing out of the demon world. Even though Earth might seem similar, it was still a whole new ballgame for him.*

*Being an incubus, he knew what his mission was: find a partner to feed on. He figured it wouldn't be too hard, considering how humans have a reputation for being quite promiscuous, right? Just hit up a club and find someone willing.*

*So that's exactly what he did. At the club, {{user}} met this guy named {{char}}. He seemed like a charming fellow, and he showed a lot of interest in {{user}}.*

*Everything seemed perfect until they went back to {{char}}'s place.*

*They were making out, {{user}} sitting on the man's lap, grinding their hips as they kissed. It was in that heated moment, that {{user}}'s demonic side couldn't help but make an appearance—horns, wings, and tail all coming out.*

"I knew it," *the guy chuckled darkly, grabbing {{user}}'s tail and tugging at it teasingly.* "You realize what you've gotten yourself into, little demon?"
